title: DC-area forecast: Rain tapers today, then gradually brighter and a bit warmer
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Overcast with occasional light showers this morning and temperatures in the 50s. A spotty shower or two could linger this afternoon with highs in the upper 50s to mid-60s and a gusty breeze.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Overcast with occasional light showers this morning and temperatures in the 50s. A spotty shower could linger this afternoon with highs in the upper 50s to mid-60s and a gusty breeze.

What’s next? Gradually brighter and somewhat warmer tomorrow and Friday with lingering breeziness. The weekend could end up nice, but the forecast is complicated by a coastal storm.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Another cloudy, damp, and cool day puts summer farther back in the rearview mirror on this first full day of fall. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Wednesday): Overcast skies as occasional light showers continue this morning with temperatures in the 50s. Still mostly cloudy this afternoon with perhaps a spotty leftover shower and highs in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Breezy winds gust from the northeast near 25 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: We should be dry this evening as skies partially clear into the overnight. Winds continue to gust from the northeast around 25 mph with lows around 50 to 55. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): Partly cloudy and breezy once again, with winds from the northeast gusting 20 to 25 mph. Otherwise still cool, but not a bad day, with highs in the mid-60s. Confidence: High

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy and rather cool with lighter winds. Overnight lows range from the upper 40s in cooler suburbs north and west, to near 50 to the low 50s elsewhere. Confidence: High

A look ahead

Friday looks like a pretty nice day with partly to mostly sunny skies. It's a bit warmer with highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. But we hang on to a breeze from the north around 10 to 15 mph. And can't rule out an isolated shower, mainly east of DC and I-95. Partly cloudy Friday night with lows in the 50s. Confidence: Medium-High

The weekend could end up partly to mostly sunny and dry, but there's a catch. The catch is that some models push a large storm system spinning off the coast closer the coast than others. If it comes close enough, then we could see more clouds and a shower chance, especially in eastern areas. Saturday and Sunday highs should be in the upper 60s to mid-70s with a lingering breeze. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 23

Late-season heat in 1988 added to one of the highest counts of 90-degree days on record, while in 2003 heavy rain on saturated ground triggered widespread flooding across the region.
